name: SpecialtyQuest Camp
description_short: Specialty day camp at the Madison Area YMCA Family Center for children entering kindergarten to grade 5, 8 to 5. Campers pick a focus (fine arts, gymnastics, performing arts, sports or ninja gym) and also get daily swim lessons, STEAM and Friday theme days.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. SpecialtyQuest 2026 at the Family Center, Sessions 1 to 5 (drop in weeks 1 to 10), 8 to 5, entering kindergarten to grade 5. Fine Arts, Performing Arts and Sports all five sessions; Gymnastics Sessions 1 and 2; Y Ninja Gym Sessions 3 to 5. No camp July 3 or August 28. Ages derived from grades, not stated. Family Center address and phone from the page footer.

Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 payment schedule: Session 1 June 22 to July 2, Session 2 July 6 to 17, Session 3 July 20 to 31, Session 4 August 3 to 14, Session 5 August 17 to 27; drop in weeks also offered. $100 nonrefundable enrollment fee at registration. Financial assistance may be available through the Y. Weekly or session prices are not posted on the site or the public ActiveNet search.

unknowns: Weekly or session price (member and non-member)

for_andrew: One of three Madison Area YMCA Quest Camps drafts (with KidsQuest and MiniQuest). No prices are posted.
